notes.title: AdventureX 2022 - Lancelot's solo dev plays his own game!
notes.notes:
[i][b]To celebrate AdventureX 2022, Jean-Baptiste (Lancelot's solo dev) will play his own game 2 years after the launch! Let's get emotional![/b][/i]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]
Lancelot's Hangover is part of the AdventureX 2022 Event from November 3 - November 9. Tons of great point&click adventure games are joining!

[h2]About the game[/h2]
Monkey Island meets Monty Python's Holy Grail in a comedy point&click game with an attitude! God gives you a quest: go find the Holy Grail, put some booze in it and celebrate the biggest party England has ever known.
